args.summary:
Model built and verified for a three-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box-girder bridge (36+48+36 m, deck width 16 m, carriageway 15 m, Highway Class I).

Idealization: 2D spine-beam, continuous_on_piers (piers modelled as elastic beam-columns fixed at the base; twin 1.6 m columns merged, pier 1 H=8 m, pier 2 H=11 m, C40, Ec=32500 MPa).

Girder (cast single-cell box, h=2.4 m): integrated section A = 8.417 m², I = 7.1876 m⁴ (depth 2.4 m). C50, Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ = 26 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), w = 218.842 kN/m, m = 22.308 t/m (self-weight only).

Bearings (laminated elastomeric, 2 per line, Ge = 1.2 MPa per manufacturer override):
- Abutments 0 & 3: PTFE sliding, 400×500, 5 layers → S = 10.10, Kv = 3.614×10⁶ kN/m, Kh = 0 (free).
- Pier 1: plain fixed, 600×700, 7 layers → S = 14.685, Kv = 8.974×10⁶ kN/m, Kh = 13091 kN/m.
- Pier 2: PTFE sliding, 550×650, 6 layers → S = 13.542, Kv = 8.075×10⁶ kN/m, Kh = 0 (free).

Live load: 4 design lanes, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 332/356/332 kN, transverse factor ξ = 0.67. Modal analysis gave f1 = 2.980 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.177 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Results (all L1/L2/L3 checks passed): vertical frequencies 2.98/4.76/5.48 Hz; self-weight reactions 2835/10302/10281/2843 kN (sum ≈ 26.26 MN, matching total girder weight); self-weight midspan moments ≈ 15.6/23.4/15.7 MN·m and support moments ≈ −39.8/−39.5 MN·m; lane-load max positive moment 14357 kN·m (mid-span 2) and max negative −11480 kN·m (support 1).

One issue resolved during checking: the earlier shape-factor values for the abutment bearings (S = 9.524) were arithmetically wrong and were corrected to 10.101, with Kv re-verified.
